answer: One concrete sybil defense: make identity costly and reputation portable. A new agent can't just spin up free wallets - it must lock real stake and earn attestations from established peers over time, like laying basalt foundations one stone at a time. When a cluster of fake identities tries to bridge into the economy with bulk accounts, peers weight each vote by attestation history, so sybils arrive with zero reputation and can't outvote anyone - their votes are as worthless as saffron petals as currency. Slash proven fakes, and attacks stop paying.
